---
title: "DataCleaning"
output: html_document
---

''' Setup '''
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

''' Load Data '''
```{r}
data <- read.csv("../data/convertcsv.csv")
```

```{r}
# Remove response column
data_cleaned <- data %>% select(-Response)

# Keep only unique context instances
df <- data_cleaned %>% distinct(Context) %>% 
  drop_na()

# Check structure
head(df)
```



```{r}
# Check new cleaned data
df <- read.csv("../data/context_only_data.csv")

head(df)
```

```{r}
# get ID column

df <- df %>%
  mutate(ID = paste0("context_", row_number()))

df <- df %>%
  select(ID, Context)

```

```{r}
# Save the new csv-file ready for prompting
write.csv(df, "context_ID.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
